title: Hai Yehi Waqt
body:
hai yehi waqt unka daaman thaam le
girne waale ab ali ka naam le
<<DIVIDER>>
marhabon ke sar pa hai tayghe ali
apna badla subho le ya shaam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai maye hubbe ali kuch tundh o tez
hurr bane jo mastiyon se kaam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ali ki neend hai hijrat ki raat
har nafas par rab se jo enaam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai abuzar se wila to apne sar
haq parasti ka bhi ek ilzaam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab hai mushkil haq o baatil mein tameez
koi karwat to dil e nakaam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
ne-mawaddat aadmi mazoor hai
jis tarha jo maani e islam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhir is chaukhat pe aana hai tujhe
jaane waale ye bhi ek paigham le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
dafn asghar ho gaye sheh ne kaha
mere bacche ab yahan aaraam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
asre ashoor aayi awaaz e rasool
fatema baazu e zainab thaam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid khane mein koi bacchi hai dafn
ek amaanat aur mulk e shaam le
hai yehi waqt...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay turabi muft hai aabe hayaat
maut ke haathon se koi jaam le
hai yehi waqt...
author: Rasheed Turabi
